title: Fix Nakshatra Loading Error - Frontend Error Handling & Retry Logic

requirements.summary: Add proper error handling and retry logic in useQueries.ts to gracefully handle canister initialization delays with user-friendly loading states
acceptanceCriteria: Frontend shows a loading spinner or initialization message during canister startup
Queries automatically retry after initialization delays without user intervention
Error messages only appear for genuine failures, not initialization delays

file_operations.description: Enhance error transformation to distinguish between initialization delays and genuine failures. Add retry logic with exponential backoff for 'service temporarily unavailable' errors. Configure retries (e.g., retry: 5, retryDelay: attemptIndex => Math.min(1000 * 2 ** attemptIndex, 30000)) to handle canister initialization gracefully. Transform 'stopped or initializing' errors into non-error loading states instead of displaying error messages.

Update loading and error state handling to display a friendly initialization message when the backend is starting up. Show a loading spinner with text like 'Initializing backend canister...' during initialization delays instead of error messages. Only display error UI for genuine query failures after all retries are exhausted.

Update error handling to distinguish between initialization delays and genuine errors. Display a loading state with initialization message while queries are retrying due to canister startup. Ensure CurrentNakshatraBanner gracefully handles initialization delays without showing error states prematurely.

Add initialization-aware error handling to distinguish between canister startup delays and genuine query failures. Display loading spinner with initialization message during backend startup retries. Only show error UI after all retry attempts are exhausted and the error is not initialization-related.

Update admin page error handling to gracefully manage canister initialization delays. Show loading state with initialization message while queries retry during backend startup. Ensure error messages only appear for genuine authorization or data fetching failures after retries complete.

Add initialization status tracking for the backend actor. Implement health check or initialization detection logic to determine when the canister is fully ready. Expose initialization state through the hook return value so components can display appropriate loading states during startup.
